body:
Azora has reached the final close of Azora Southern Europe Opportunities III (SEO III) with €1.6 billion ($1.79 billion) in commitments.

The value-added fund attracted more than €2.1 billion ($2.35 billion) of interest from institutional investors. Azora also raised €450 million ($504 million) of co-investment capital for larger transactions, bringing total capital raised for the strategy to €2.05 billion ($2.3 billion) and providing approximately €4.5 billion ($5.04 billion) of investment capacity.

The fund attracted nearly 30 investors, including pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, endowments and family offices from Europe, Asia, North America and the Middle East. SEO III invests across living, hospitality, logistics, office, urban properties and land, as well as a digital strategy focused on data centers. Development and active management are part of the fund’s investment strategy.
